about: What the tablet's own screen says (CONTRACT.md section 11). The firmware's words: TAB-1 checks engine/tab_state.h and its screens against this file, and the panel's tests read the tablet's words from here. {hotspot} is the set-up hotspot's name (below). {name} is the tablet's name as the waiting screen shows it above the headline: the ESPHome friendly name with the last six characters of the MAC, which is also the name Home Assistant gives the tablet when it adds it.

hotspot.when: No Wi-Fi, the set-up hotspot is on
hotspot.headline: Set up Wi-Fi
hotspot.step: Join the Wi-Fi “{hotspot}” from a phone

connecting.when: No Wi-Fi yet, the hotspot not on yet (a known Wi-Fi is tried first, up to 90 s)
connecting.headline: Connecting to Wi-Fi…
connecting.step: If it cannot connect, its set-up hotspot comes on within 2 minutes

add.when: On Wi-Fi, no key, never erased (or erased over USB), Home Assistant not connected
add.headline: Add this tablet in Home Assistant
add.step: It shows up by itself in Settings > Devices & services

erased.when: The same after the hold-the-screen erase, until the tablet has a key again
erased.headline: Confirm this tablet in Home Assistant
erased.step: In Settings > System > Repairs, confirm only “Authentication expired for {name}”
erased.step_long_name: In Settings > System > Repairs, confirm only “Authentication expired” for the name above
erased.step2: If this Home Assistant never had this tablet, add it in Settings > Devices & services

starting.when: Home Assistant connected, the tablet has its key, TAB-1 has not greeted it yet (8 s for a tablet never turned on, 5 minutes for one turned on before)
starting.headline: Waiting for TAB-1 in Home Assistant
starting.step: If Home Assistant has finished starting, open TAB-1 there and turn this tablet on

turn_on.when: Home Assistant connected, no greeting from TAB-1 after that wait (8 s for a tablet without a key)
turn_on.headline: Ready to turn on
turn_on.step: Open TAB-1 in Home Assistant and turn this tablet on

wait_ha.when: The tablet has its key, Home Assistant not connected
wait_ha.headline: Waiting for Home Assistant
wait_ha.step: Check that Home Assistant is running and lists this tablet in Settings > Devices & services

loading.when: TAB-1 greeted it, a dashboard on its way (or the first 3 s after the greeting)
loading.headline: Connected to Home Assistant

pick.when: TAB-1 greeted it, nothing to show (tab_clear, or no dashboard 3 s after the greeting)
pick.headline: Nothing to show yet
pick.step: Open TAB-1 in Home Assistant to see what this tablet should show

closed.when: The 15-minute set-up window closed without a key
closed.headline: Setup not finished
closed.step: Restart the tablet to finish setup

no_wifi.when: The set-up window closed on a tablet with its key that had no Wi-Fi
no_wifi.headline: No Wi-Fi
no_wifi.step: Turn the tablet off and on, then join “{hotspot}” from a phone

hotspot.when: Over a dashboard, Home Assistant not connected: no Wi-Fi, the set-up hotspot is on
hotspot.text: No Wi-Fi. Join the Wi-Fi “{hotspot}” from a phone

connecting.when: Over a dashboard, Home Assistant not connected: no Wi-Fi for 20 s, the hotspot not on yet
connecting.text: No Wi-Fi. Its set-up hotspot comes on within 2 minutes

off_on.when: Over a dashboard: the set-up window closed on a tablet with its key that had no Wi-Fi
off_on.text: No Wi-Fi. Turn the tablet off and on, then join “{hotspot}” from a phone
